headline: Sri Lanka inflation projected to reach 9-pct by month-end: Central Bank Governor
summary: Sri Lanka's inflation is expected to remain elevated in the near term, reaching around 9% by month-end, according to the central bank governor. Levels are higher than expected compared with the last policy review.
why: Inflation is a key input for central bank policy decisions, and it affects interest rates, bond yields and the currency in Sri Lanka.
